title: Failure ownership
summary: A failing or flaky test is a defect. Fix failures caused by this item or in files it touches here, commit and re-run the gate. For an unrelated cause, file feedback, promote a fix item, record a dependency and park; the gate stays red until the fix lands. Never weaken a behavior assertion or re-run unchanged inputs to get a pass. Cancelled or never-started jobs are no verdict and remain recoverable.
